what_it_does: Enables real-time video instance segmentation—identifying and outlining objects in video frames—in very low light conditions on resource-constrained edge devices like autonomous vehicles and security cameras. The system uses YOLOv8 object detection architecture optimized through number format quantization, which reduces how many bits are used to represent neural network weights and activations. Techniques include representing weights in 8-bit integer format, custom brightness preprocessing, and pipeline-based parallelism to process video frames in real time.
